record_type_quote:
We examined the replicability of the co-witness suggestibility effect originally reported by

Garry et al. (2008) by testing participants from 10 countries (Brazil, Canada, Colombia, India,

Japan, Malaysia, Poland, Portugal, Turkey, and the United Kingdom, total N = 486).

targets.authors: Garry, M., French, L., Kinzett, T., & Mori, K.
targets.title: Eyewitness memory following discussion: Using the MORI technique with a western sample.
targets.evidence_quote:
We examined the replicability of the co-witness suggestibility effect originally reported by

Garry et al. (2008) by testing participants from 10 countries (Brazil, Canada, Colombia, India,

Japan, Malaysia, Poland, Portugal, Turkey, and the United Kingdom, total N = 486).
targets.outcome_quote:
We successfully replicated the findings of Garry et

al. (2008) in each sample: Accuracy on the final individual recognition test was lower for

critical discussed questions than for non-discussed control questions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly judge replication successful in every sample. Ten sites repeat one original paper, so one target.
